The Boss Gangsters: Nightlife | First Gameplay Showcase

Step into the criminal underworld in The Boss Gangsters: Nightlife.
Manage your club, handle drunk troublemakers, and expand your empire through crime and chaos. But remember… every boss faces his final night.
